issues.description: The problem statement's UML specifies SealSaloon.totalOrders as an int, but the solution implementation declares totalOrders as a long. This discrepancy between the specified type (int) and the implemented type (long) may confuse students about the intended type and expectations for that attribute.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the type of totalOrders consistent across materials. Either change the implementation in src/de/tum/cit/ase/SealSaloon.java to use int for totalOrders, or update the problem statement/UML to specify long. Prefer changing the implementation to int to match the UML and keep the attribute lightweight unless there is a documented reason to require long.
